q1: SELECT b.name AS bar, COUNT(DISTINCT f.drinker) AS num_drinker, AVG(s.price) AS avg_price, (SELECT f1.drinker FROM frequents AS f1 WHERE f1.bar = b.name ORDER BY f1.times_a_week DESC, f1.drinker ASC LIMIT 1) AS most_reg_drinker FROM bar AS b LEFT JOIN frequents AS f ON b.name = f.bar LEFT JOIN serves AS s ON b.name = s.bar GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY num_drinker DESC, b.name ASC
q2: WITH numDrinker AS (SELECT bar, COUNT(drinker) AS num FROM frequents GROUP BY bar), avgPrice AS (SELECT bar, AVG(price) AS price FROM serves GROUP BY bar), mostReg AS (SELECT bar, drinker FROM frequents AS f1 WHERE f1.times_a_week = (SELECT MAX(f2.times_a_week) FROM frequents AS f2 WHERE f1.bar = f2.bar) AND f1.drinker = (SELECT MIN(f2.drinker) FROM frequents AS f2 WHERE f1.bar = f2.bar AND f2.times_a_week = f2.times_a_week)) SELECT bar.name, COALESCE(numDrinker.num, 0) AS num, avgPrice.price, mostReg.drinker FROM bar LEFT JOIN numDrinker ON bar.name = numDrinker.bar LEFT JOIN avgPrice ON bar.name = avgPrice.bar LEFT JOIN mostReg ON bar.name = mostReg.bar ORDER BY num DESC, bar.name
